verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs say developer packages, tools and runtimes are ready to install with a single command. They also describe ready-to-use container tooling and easy VMs through Boxes, which give building blocks for development environments. However, nothing shows preconfigured, framework- or language-specific environments that set themselves up quickly, so the developer must assemble them. Missing for 10: preconfigured environment templates or stacks for specific frameworks and languages, details on which languages and runtimes are covered, and independent or hands-on confirmation of quick setup.
